task_text: Press Button: A wall stands in front of the hovering aerial manipulator, and a push button is mounted flat on the wall's front face, facing the robot: a red circular plunger in a dark-grey circular housing. Press the button, i.e. push its spring-loaded plunger into the housing, along the wall's normal, until it is depressed by at least 4 mm (40 % of its 10 mm travel). Success: Success when the button's prismatic joint PlungerSlideJoint has position >= 0.004 m (button_pressed_threshold; the joint ranges from 0 m, unpressed, to 0.01 m, fully pressed; positive = plunger pushed into the housing toward the wall). Evaluated after every control step (decimation 1, so after every 1/120 s physics step) on the simulated state; no hold time is required. The episode terminates at the first step where it holds. Otherwise it is truncated by the time limit: episode_length_s = 20 s, i.e. max_episode_length = 2400 control steps; AM-Bench raises the time-out when episode_length_buf >= max_episode_length - 1, i.e. at the 2399th step.
episode: one episode, no reset: it ends at the first control step where AM-Bench's success check holds, when the task's episode length of 20 s of simulated time runs out (AM-Bench's time-out, at control step 2399), when your time is up, or on a simulator error; the simulated clock advances only with the control steps you run
